description: This file defines the ExtendedSpringLiquibaseBuilder class, which is a builder for configuring and creating instances of ExtendedSpringLiquibase, used for managing Liquibase database migrations within a Spring Boot application. The class encapsulates configuration parameters derived from LiquibaseProperties and provides methods to customize the setup, such as setting the data source, context, resource loader, and other Liquibase options.

classes.name: ExtendedSpringLiquibaseBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating ExtendedSpringLiquibase instances with fluent interface methods for setting properties.

methods.name: withDataSource
methods.description: Sets the DataSource for the Liquibase configuration.

methods.name: withContext
methods.description: Adds a single context to the list of Liquibase contexts.

methods.name: withContexts (varargs & collection)
methods.description: Adds multiple contexts to the list of Liquibase contexts.

methods.name: withResourceLoader
methods.description: Sets the ResourceLoader for the Liquibase configuration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns an ExtendedSpringLiquibase object configured with the accumulated properties.
